Joe Tache

Socialism and Liberation candidate for Senator in Congress, Massachusetts · Challenger

Community organizer

Joe Tache, also listed as Joseph Tache, is a community organizer from Boston who grew up in Roxbury and has been active in the Party for Socialism and Liberation since 2018. He launched his U.S. Senate campaign in October 2025. He is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot under the Socialism and Liberation designation, running against incumbent Democrat Ed Markey, Republican John Deaton and independent Shiva Ayyadurai.

Where Tache stands

Economy and cost of living
Says capitalism is a national emergency and socialism is the solution. Argues that rents and prices in Massachusetts are too high and that billionaires hoard resources.
Senate filibuster
Calls the filibuster an anti-democratic tool that blocks policies he says most people in the country support.
Wealth inequality
Says the richest 900 people in the U.S. own as much wealth as the poorest 170 million, and argues for moving the economy toward socialism.

Background

  • Community organizer and activist, Boston area

  • Studied business at Northeastern University
